metadata.subtitle: Post Falls Dam to Lake Coeur d'Alene · Kootenai County, Idaho
metadata.status: Draft for review — not yet adopted
metadata.criteria: Current rules: no wake within 100 ft · no towing within 150 ft · surf guideline 200 ft (from shore and docks) · lanes 3,000 ft
metadata.tow_hours: No towing anywhere from 1 h after sunset to 1 h before sunrise (Idaho Code § 67-7024(1)–(3), (6)).
metadata.disclaimer: Screening map, not a navigation chart or legal determination. Posted buoys, signs and officers govern. A dock, boom or swim float missing from our data still counts — keep 100 ft (no wake) and 150 ft (no towing). Rules about swimmers, divers and moving boats can't be mapped — keep the required distance from anyone you see. Setbacks are measured from the summer full-pool shoreline; the law measures from today's waterline, so at low water the lines sit further out. Zone boundaries are approximate (not yet surveyed).
metadata.credits: Shoreline: USGS 3DHP (2023), the same outline as the HLWID ArcGIS draft; lake approach: USGS NHD High Resolution. Depth: Coeur d'Alene Tribe / Avista Corp. bathymetric contours (5-ft interval, 2004 compilation). Docks: OpenStreetMap piers plus docks added by hand; the shoreline outline notches around many larger docks. Automatic detections are left out until reviewed. Piers, booms, swim areas: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Imagery: USGS The National Map (public domain); Esri World Imagery optional. Live data: USGS Water Services, NOAA/NWS.
metadata.made_by: Made by Cole Van Hersett for Hayden Lake Watershed Improvement District (HLWID) review

properties.name: No wake — 5 mph
properties.description: No wake — idle or steerage speed, never over 5 mph. Within 100 ft of shore, docks and structures, plus the designated zones, which carry their own rules: no-wake zones 5 mph with a wake under 4 in, no-motor zones no motors at all, no-entry zones keep out (see "Designated zones").

properties.name: Wake OK — no towing
properties.description: Wake OK, no towing: 100–150 ft from shore/docks/structures. Inside the county's 150-ft no-tow setback: no skiing, tubing or wakeboarding; wake surfing treated the same (interpretation). Speed limits 35 mph day / 25 night.

properties.name: Tow zone, 150–200 ft
properties.description: Tow zone, 150–200 ft from shore, docks and structures — outside Kootenai County's No Waterskiing Zone: skiing, tubing, wakeboarding; wake surfing treated the same (interpretation). Tow zone in total (150 ft+): 271 ac. No towing anywhere from 1 h after sunset to 1 h before sunrise (Idaho Code § 67-7024(1)–(3), (6)).

properties.name: Tow zone + 200-ft surf guideline
properties.description: Tow zone that also meets the 200-ft wake-surf guideline from shore, docks and structures (WSIA Wake Responsibly / IDPR Mind Your Wake — guideline, not law). Tow zone in total (150 ft+): 271 ac. No towing anywhere from 1 h after sunset to 1 h before sunrise (Idaho Code § 67-7024(1)–(3), (6)).

properties.name: Straight lanes 3,000 ft+
properties.description: Straight lanes at least 3,000 ft long and 50 ft wide inside the tow zone.

properties.name: No-wake: Lake Coeur d'Alene to 300 ft below the US-95 bridge
properties.description: KCC 6.2.122 (Res. 2021-37). Boundary approximate — the 300-ft line below the bridge needs HLWID's marker.

properties.name: Black Bay — no motor-driven watercraft
properties.description: KCC 6.2.122: Black Bay is closed to motor-driven watercraft (stricter than no-wake). Boundary approximate.

properties.name: No-wake: east end of Templin's Marina to Post Falls Dam
properties.description: KCC 6.2.122 (Res. 2010-01). The east end of the marina is approximate — confirm with HLWID's marker.

properties.name: No Entry — between the dam and the safety boom
properties.description: KCC 6.2.123: no entry at any time between the Post Falls dams and the boater safety cable. Avista: equipment can start without warning.

properties.name: No Entry when posted — safety boom to the S. Spokane St bridge
properties.description: KCC 6.2.123: closed whenever posted (typically outside Avista's summer operations, which open this stretch and the Q'emiln launch and beach in mid/late June).

properties.name: Blackwell Island Canal — no motor-driven watercraft
properties.description: KCC 6.2.122(A)(2)(d): no motors from the US-95 canal bridge downstream to 50 ft above the BLM launch; from there to the river is exempt. Boundaries approximate.

properties.name: Hwy 95 bridge to Lake Coeur d'Alene — no wake
properties.description: Main channel: county designated no-wake zone. Blackwell Island side channels: inside the 100-ft no-wake band; the canal is also no-motor.

properties.name: 100-ft no-wake line
properties.description: No-wake setback: no wake on the shore side of this line (100 ft from shore and docks). Designated zones apply on their own.

properties.name: 150-ft no-tow line
properties.description: County no-tow setback: no towing on the shore side of this line (150 ft from shore and docks).

properties.name: 200-ft surf-guideline line
properties.description: The 200-ft wake-surf guideline is met on the river side of this line (guideline, not law).

properties.name: Post Falls Dam — North Channel (Avista)
properties.note: No entry between the dam and the boater safety cable at any time (KCC 6.2.123). Equipment can start without warning.

properties.name: Post Falls Dam — South Channel (Avista)
properties.note: No entry between the dam and the safety boom at any time (KCC 6.2.123).

properties.name: Spokane Street Bridge (Post Falls)
properties.note: Closure signs on the bridge mark the seasonal No Entry zone downstream of it. Vertical clearance not verified.

properties.name: Q'emiln Park boat launch (City of Post Falls)
properties.note: Two-lane ramp below the Spokane Street Bridge; opens with Avista summer operations (mid/late June). Idle under the bridge to reach the river. Fees and hours: check the City of Post Falls.

properties.name: Q'emiln Park
properties.note: City park with swim beach — swimmers likely in summer.

properties.name: Q'emiln Park restrooms
properties.note: Restrooms near the launch.

properties.name: Post Falls Landing marina (River's Edge)
properties.note: Slips and docks — structures for the setback rules.

properties.name: Falls Park (City of Post Falls / Avista)
properties.note: Shore park by the dam (below the reach).

properties.name: Templin's fuel dock
properties.note: Reported as the only fuel on the reach. Hours not verified.

properties.name: Templin's pump-out (private)
properties.note: Pump-out reported at the marina; confirm availability.

properties.name: Fun Unlimited Post Falls (rentals)
properties.note: Boat and PWC rentals (verify season and hours).

properties.name: Red Lion Templin's restaurant & marina grill
properties.note: Boat-in dining at the marina.

properties.name: Black Bay Park (City of Post Falls)
properties.note: Shore access only — Black Bay itself is a no-motor zone (KCC 6.2.122).

properties.name: Rock outcrop at the head of Black Bay
properties.note: Mapped rock outcrop (OpenStreetMap). Inside the no-motor zone.

properties.name: Greensferry boat launch (Kootenai County)
properties.note: County launch on the south bank, inside Greensferry Bay; closed 10 p.m.–5 a.m. At the county dock: moor no more than 48 h in any 72, no rafting, quiet hours 10 p.m.–8 a.m. (KCC 6.2.122(B)). Surface and fees reported, not verified — check before bringing a heavy wakeboat.

properties.name: Green's Ferry bridge site (demolished)
properties.note: A bridge once crossed here; old pilings may remain below the surface. Unverified.

properties.name: Informal beach (south bank)
properties.note: Informal beach — people may be in the water.

properties.name: Ross Point Camp & Conference Center waterfront
properties.note: Private camp waterfront — swimmers and paddlers likely in summer.

properties.name: Kiwanis Park swim beach (City of Post Falls)
properties.note: Unguarded city swim beach — swimmers in summer; no wake within 100 ft of people in the water.

properties.name: West Harbor Drive bridge (Harbor Island back channel)
properties.note: Low bridge over the back channel; vertical clearance not verified.

properties.name: Johnson Mill River Park day-use dock (City of Coeur d'Alene)
properties.note: City day-use dock: no mooring 10 p.m.–6 a.m. or more than 6 hours in any 12; no swimming or wading within 100 ft of the dock (Coeur d'Alene Code §§ 4.20.050–.060).

properties.name: Johnson Mill River Park swim beach
properties.note: Swim beach — swimmers likely in summer.

properties.name: Atlas Mill Park / Atlas Waterfront (City of Coeur d'Alene)
properties.note: Waterfront park with paddle access.

properties.name: Atlas Mill Park ADA kayak launch
properties.note: Floating paddle launch — paddlers on the water.

properties.name: USGS 12417650 Spokane River below Blackwell
properties.note: The only stream gauge inside the reach (flow and stage). Live readings on the page header.

properties.name: Blackwell Island boat launch (BLM)
properties.note: Inside the lake-approach no-wake zone. The Blackwell Island Canal upstream is no-motor except from 50 ft above this launch down to the river (KCC 6.2.122(A)(2)(d)). Shallow flats off the ramp at low water.

properties.name: Shallow flats off the Blackwell Island launch
properties.note: Shallow at fall/winter levels (2004 contours).

properties.name: US-95 bridge over the Spokane River
properties.note: No-wake from the lake to 300 ft downstream of this bridge (KCC 6.2.122(A)(1)(a)). ITD posts signs and buoys showing where to pass under during work.

properties.name: US-95 bridge over Blackwell Slough
properties.note: Upstream end of the Blackwell Island Canal no-motor zone.

properties.name: Hagadone Marine boat ramp (Blackwell Slough)
properties.note: Private/marina ramp in the slough — no-motor rules apply in the canal (KCC 6.2.122(A)(2)(d)).

properties.name: Blackwell Island Marina (Hagadone Marine Group)
properties.note: Marina in the Blackwell Island Canal by the lake. Powerboats reach the lake from here, not the river — the canal north of the US-95 bridge is no-motor (KCC 6.2.122(A)(2)(d)).

properties.name: Blackwell Island Marina fuel dock
properties.note: Fuel reported at the marina (verify).

properties.name: Cedars Floating Restaurant
properties.note: Boat-in dining at the lake end of the slough.

properties.name: North Idaho College beach
properties.note: Busy swim beach at the river mouth — inside the lake-approach no-wake zone.

properties.name: Shallow spot west of Black Bay
properties.note: Under ~5 ft at full pool in the 2004 contours — shallower at fall/winter levels. Screening only; not field-checked.

properties.name: Shallow spot off the south bank
properties.note: Under ~5 ft at full pool in the 2004 contours — shallower at fall/winter levels. Screening only; not field-checked.

properties.name: Shallow spot opposite Ross Point
properties.note: Under ~5 ft at full pool in the 2004 contours — shallower at fall/winter levels. Screening only; not field-checked.

properties.name: Shallow shelf off the south bank west of Harbor Island
properties.note: Water under ~5 ft reaches about 50 m out from the south bank here (2004 contours, full pool). Shallower at fall/winter levels.

properties.name: Shallow bar off Harbor Island's northwest shore
properties.note: Two small under-5-ft spots in 5–10 ft water near the island (2004 contours). Shallower at fall/winter levels.

properties.name: Shallow spot and possible old pilings off the Atlas waterfront
properties.note: One tiny under-5-ft spot in a 15-ft pool (2004 contours). Old log pilings, some submerged, are reported from Cedars to the dam (CdA Press, 2010).

properties.name: Shallow flat off Bellerive
properties.note: Shallow flat about 36 m off the north bank — depths under 10 ft for 70 m around. Boats have hit old pilings in this narrow stretch (CdA Press, 2010).

properties.name: Ross Point Day Use Site (BLM)
properties.note: BLM day-use site on the north bank: roped swim area and a floating dock for fishing and non-motorized craft. Swimmers and paddlers likely in summer.

properties.name: Ross Point
properties.note: Place name for orientation (Ross Point Camp waterfront).

properties.name: Shallow bar in Greensferry Bay
properties.note: Mid-bay bar about 300 m north of the ramp: a ~1.3 ha area under 10 ft with an under-5-ft core, in 15–25 ft water (2004 contours, full pool).

properties.name: Rodkey Drive shore access (Kootenai County)
properties.note: 10-ft public pathway to the north bank — carry-in access only. Closed 10 p.m.–5 a.m. (KCC 6.2.122(B)).

properties.name: "Mile 7" no-wake channel — location to confirm
properties.note: KCC 6.2.122(A)(1)(c) designates "the channel between the shoreline and the island and wetlands area at mile 7 on the south side" as no-wake. Counted from the lake, mile 7 falls near Greensferry Bay, which has a south-side island — the likeliest match, but unconfirmed. Not drawn as a zone until HLWID or the county confirms.

properties.name: Boater safety boom — North Channel Dam
properties.note: Avista boater safety boom/cable. Never cross it: KCC 6.2.123 makes the water between it and the dam No Entry at all times.

properties.name: Boater safety boom — South Channel Dam
properties.note: Avista boater safety boom/cable. Never cross it: KCC 6.2.123 makes the water between it and the dam No Entry at all times.
